title: Bilsborough et al. (2011) PNAS, Barkoulas et al. (2008) Nat. Genet., Vlad et al. (2014) Science & Kierzkowski et al. (2019) Cell — PIN1-Auxin-CUC2-RCO Feedback Loop & Leaf Margin Serration vs Compound Leaflet Dissection
organism: Arabidopsis thaliana / Cardamine hirsuta (growing leaf margin epidermis, serration teeth, and compound leaflets)

primary_sources.citation: Bilsborough, Runions, Barkoulas, Jenkins, Hasson, Galinha, Laufs, Hay, Prusinkiewicz & Tsiantis (2011) PNAS 108(8):3424-3429
primary_sources.role: 1D/2D growing epidermal margin model coupling Loop 1 (CUC2-promoted PIN1 up-the-gradient polarization rho_{ij} propto (1 + gamma_CUC2 * C_i) * exp(beta * A_j) generating periodic auxin convergence maxima at tooth tips), Loop 2 (Auxin transcriptional repression of CUC2, C_i = C_max / (1 + (A_i / K_A)^n), restricting CUC2 to inter-tooth sinuses), and Loop 3 (differential normal margin outgrowth v_n(s) = v_0 * [A(s)^m / (K_g^m + A(s)^m)] * (1 - eta_sinus * C(s)) with intercalary tooth insertion as inter-peak arc-length exceeds critical wavelength lambda_c)

primary_sources.citation: Barkoulas, Hay, Kougioumoutzi & Tsiantis (2008) Nature Genetics 40(9):1136-1141
primary_sources.role: Demonstrates that PIN1-mediated auxin convergence peaks and KNOX/CUC transcription factors pattern compound leaflet initiation along the growing rachis margin of Cardamine hirsuta

Identifies REDUCED COMPLEXITY (RCO), a homeobox gene expressed specifically at the base/sinus flanks of developing leaflets in Cardamine hirsuta (and lost in Arabidopsis thaliana), which locally represses sinus growth without altering PIN1/auxin convergence spacing, converting shallow serrations into deeply dissected compound leaflets

primary_sources.citation: Kierzkowski, Runions, Vuolo, Strauss, Lymbouridou, Routier-Kierzkowska et al. (2019) Cell 177(6):1405-1418
primary_sources.role: Live cellular growth tracking and computational morphodynamic modeling showing how CUC2/RCO local growth repression at sinuses and KNOX/STM prolonged meristematic competence transform simple serrated Arabidopsis leaves into compound Cardamine hirsuta leaves

genotype_morphospace_benchmarks.species: Arabidopsis thaliana (cuc2-1 / pin1 smooth margin mutant)
Cardamine hirsuta (Ox wild-type pinnately compound leaf with CUC2 + RCO + STM)

intercalary_growth_stages_benchmarks.description: Apical terminal auxin convergence maximum only (single tip)
First symmetric pair of lateral auxin/PIN1 convergence peaks flanking CUC2 sinuses
Second basipetal/intercalary pair of teeth/leaflets inserted as inter-peak spacing exceeds lambda_c
Three lateral pairs + terminal leaflet (7 peaks) with deep RCO-repressed rachis sinuses

specimen_metadata.author: Wikimedia Commons Botanical Archive
specimen_metadata.description: Flat-mounted studio botanical specimen of Cardamine hirsuta against a white background displaying developmental heteroblasty from simple basal leaves to pinnately compound cauline/rosette leaves with distinct lateral and terminal leaflets separated by deep rachis sinuses.
